verdict.rationale: Tavily documents two relevant capabilities. Extract can batch up to 20 URLs per request, with per-URL failures reported separately. Research tasks run asynchronously and their status and results are retrieved later by request ID, with optional streaming. However, there is no documented batch or async job submission for high-volume search queries; Search appears to be one request per query under RPM limits. missing for 10: batch/bulk search query endpoint, async job queue for high-volume search workloads, batch-specific pricing or limits, independent corroboration.
